products.name: Inspection Access Readiness
products.product: A focused home inspection property access readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent home inspection companies and small multi-inspector teams
products.problem: Inspectors arrive without confirmed utilities, occupied-area access, crawlspace or attic entry, outbuilding keys, seller instructions, agreements, payment, or agent contacts.
products.valueProposition: Turns home inspection property access readiness into a visible operating queue so every inspection starts with property-specific access, utilities, scope, agreement, payment, and contacts confirmed or a documented limitation plan.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets home inspection checklist before appointment, home inspector access confirmation, inspection scheduling software, and property inspection readiness searches.

products.name: Report Release QA
products.product: A focused home inspection report quality review workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent home inspection companies and small multi-inspector teams
products.problem: A report can be sent with placeholder text, contradictory selections, missing media, wrong property details, unsupported language, broken links, or unreviewed automated draft content.
products.valueProposition: Turns home inspection report quality review into a visible operating queue so every inspection report is released only after an accountable inspector reviews identity, completeness, consistency, media, recommendations, and client delivery.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets home inspection report QA, inspection report checklist, home inspector report software, and property inspection quality control searches.
